# Public extension content

This repository and its extension are public. Skill and agent changes must enter through an approving pull request, not a workstation publish or direct push.

Never copy a user's home-folder configuration into this repository as part of a build, sync or publication step. Review shipped content for customer-specific, internal or sensitive information. Do not bypass the publishability or CI-only publishing guards.
